HOOK_TEXT: One tired tap can beat MFA
SAY: Your phone buzzes. Approve login? You didn't try to log in.
ON_SCREEN: "Approve sign-in?"
BROLL: Mock approval prompt on a phone
SAY: This is MFA fatigue. Attackers with your password spam prompts until someone taps yes.
ON_SCREEN: MFA fatigue
SAY: It works because of habituation. Tap approve enough times and your brain stops reading.
SAY: Sometimes they even call and say, I'm from IT, just approve it.
ON_SCREEN: "IT here, just approve it" = red flag
SAY: Rule: never approve a prompt you didn't start. Deny it, and change your password.
ON_SCREEN: Deny, change password, report
SAY: Better still, use passkeys or security keys, which resist this trick.
SAY: Report surprise prompts. They mean your password is already out there. Save this for your next MFA rollout.
TITLE: How attackers beat MFA with one tap
CAPTION: MFA is great, but a tired tap can undo it. Deny prompts you didn't trigger, change your password, and tell your security team. Passkeys and security keys resist this trick. Ever got a surprise prompt? #MFA #Passkeys #InfoSec
